reference_conditions.label: Calibration before use of a measuring instrument
reference_conditions.description: Where a measuring act uses a material artifact as its instrument, a calibration act on that instrument must precede the measuring act.

objective.label: measurement results are trustworthy
objective.description: Measurements used to decide product acceptance are produced with instruments whose accuracy has been established.
objective.rationale: An uncalibrated instrument cannot support an acceptance decision.

reference_conditions.satisfaction_condition: A calibration act on the instrument precedes the measuring act.
